problem:
The affine transformation $T$ is defined as

$$
x=2u-3v-4,\,y=2u-4v-5.
$$

Given that the inverse transformation ${T}^{-1}$ of $T$ is

$$
u=2x+ay+b,\,v=x-y+c,
$$

what is the value of $a+b+c?$

activity_context.topic_title: The Inverse of an Affine Transformation

feedback.problem:
The affine transformation $T$ is defined as

$$
x=5u-9v-2,\,y=4u-8v+4.
$$

Given that the inverse transformation ${T}^{-1}$ of $T$ is

$$
u=ax-\frac{9}{4}y+b,\,v=cx-\frac{5}{4}y+7.
$$

what is the value of $a+b+c?$
feedback.worked_solution:
An affine transformation $T:{R}^{2}\to {R}^{2}$ is a function of the form

$$
x=Au+b,
$$

where $x,u,$ and $b$ are column vectors in ${R}^{2},$ and $A$ is a $2\times 2$ matrix.

Reversing the action of $T,$ we get

$$
\begin{aligned}Au+b & =x \\ Au & =x-b \\ u & ={A}^{-1}(x-b).\end{aligned}
$$

So, writing our transformation in matrix form, we have

$$
\begin{aligned}[\begin{aligned}x \\ y\end{aligned}] & =[\begin{aligned}5u-9v-2 \\ 4u-8v+4\end{aligned}] \\  & =[\begin{aligned}5u-9v \\ 4u-8v\end{aligned}]+[\begin{aligned}-2 \\ 4\end{aligned}] \\  & ={{[\begin{aligned}5 & -9 \\ 4 & -8\end{aligned}]}_{⏟}}_{A}\cdot {{[\begin{aligned}u \\ v\end{aligned}]}_{⏟}}_{u}+{{[\begin{aligned}-2 \\ 4\end{aligned}]}_{⏟}}_{b}.\end{aligned}
$$

Next, we calculate the inverse of $A:$

$$
\begin{aligned}{A}^{-1} & =\frac{1}{-8\cdot 5-(-9)\cdot 4}[\begin{aligned}-8 & 9 \\ -4 & 5\end{aligned}] \\  & =\frac{1}{-4}[\begin{aligned}-8 & 9 \\ -4 & 5\end{aligned}] \\  & =[\begin{aligned}2 & -\frac{9}{4} \\ 1 & -\frac{5}{4}\end{aligned}].\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore, the inverse transformation ${T}^{-1}$ is

$$
\begin{aligned}{{[\begin{aligned}u \\ v\end{aligned}]}_{⏟}}_{u} & ={{[\begin{aligned}2 & -\frac{9}{4} \\ 1 & -\frac{5}{4}\end{aligned}]}_{⏟}}_{{A}^{-1}}\cdot ({{[\begin{aligned}x \\ y\end{aligned}]}_{⏟}}_{x}-{{[\begin{aligned}-2 \\ 4\end{aligned}]}_{⏟}}_{b}) \\  & =[\begin{aligned}2 & -\frac{9}{4} \\ 1 & -\frac{5}{4}\end{aligned}][\begin{aligned}x+2 \\ y-4\end{aligned}] \\  & =[\begin{aligned}2\cdot (x+2)-\frac{9}{4}\cdot (y-4) \\ 1\cdot (x+2)+(-\frac{5}{4})\cdot (y-4)\end{aligned}] \\  & =[\begin{aligned}2x-\frac{9}{4}y+13 \\ x-\frac{5}{4}y+7\end{aligned}]\end{aligned}
$$

Equating the corresponding components, the inverse transformation ${T}^{-1}$ in coordinate form is

$$
u=2x-\frac{9}{4}y+13,\,v=1x-\frac{5}{4}y+7.
$$

Therefore, we have

$$
a+b+c=2+13+1=16.
$$
